theme_and_archetype.archetype: 6 (Vibrant Play) blended with Neo-Brutalist Pixel Retro
theme_and_archetype.mood: Playful, colorful, nostalgic yet clean and modern (Seth Lukin inspired)

scale.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-[5rem] tracking-tighter font-black leading-none

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Bento grid for case studies (e.g., grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6 or gap-8). Focus on asymmetry.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Optical alignment, chunky spacing, generous negative space.

visual_style.borders: border-2 or border-[3px] border-[#0A0A0A] for a chunky, retro brutalist feel.
visual_style.shadows: Hard drop shadows: shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(10,10,10,1)] or shadow-[8px_8px_0px_0px_rgba(10,10,10,1)]
visual_style.radii: rounded-2xl for main containers, mixed with sharp pixel art decorations.
visual_style.decorations: Use inline SVG pixel sparkles/stars scattered around the hero and stats sections.

components_instructions.hero: Massive 'LET'S BUILD TOGETHER' heading in Outfit font. Include status badges (Location, Local Time, Status) using VT323 pixel font, rounded borders, and hard black outlines.
components_instructions.intro_section: Big text 'YOUR NAME', role tags in colorful pill-shapes with hard shadows. Mission statement paragraph in large body font.
components_instructions.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee or CSS marquee. Massive outline text or bright colored background with black text. Separate items with ✦ pixel star.
components_instructions.case_study_cards: Bento-style layout for 3 projects. Images in the top portion, bottom portion for title and tags. Hard black outer borders, solid white background, hard black offset shadow on hover.
components_instructions.stats_block: Stat block with pixel sparkle decorations and a playful layout.
components_instructions.contact_section_and_modal: Contact section with email, LinkedIn, GitHub and a 'Start a Project' CTA button. CTA opens a Shadcn Dialog modal with a form that saves to MongoDB.
components_instructions.cursor: Implement a custom playful cursor using framer-motion (e.g., a colored circle that follows the mouse with slight spring lag), hide default cursor on desktop.
components_instructions.footer: Chunky footer with large display text and social links. Contrasting background color.

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Interactive elements should move up and left (-translate-y-1 -translate-x-1) and increase their hard shadow.
motion_and_interaction.page_transitions: Subtle fade-in and slide-up for sections on mount.
motion_and_interaction.microinteractions: Bouncy spring animations on buttons and cards using framer-motion (type: 'spring', stiffness: 300, damping: 20).

case_study_1.description: Colorful laptop workspace for Portfolio project

case_study_2.description: Futuristic AI chip for 60 Days to AI project

case_study_3.description: Laptop with code for Projects Personal

testing_requirements.attributes: All interactive elements and key informational areas MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute in kebab-case based on role.
